meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先反问你想做什么，再帮你给 NanoClaw 加输入渠道、改触发规则、加集成或改路由，改完还告诉你怎么验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加渠道（Telegram、Slack、邮件等）、改触发器、加集成或修改路由时，它会接管，并先提问确认需求。

say.text: 帮我加一个 Telegram 输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问你接到哪个 agent group

say.text: 把 Slack 的触发规则改成唤醒我的客服 agent group
say.note: 会更新对应 wiring 的触发规则

say.text: 给这个 agent group 加一个 Gmail 工具

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first asks what you want, then helps you add input channels, change triggers, add integrations or modify the router for NanoClaw, and tells you how to verify the change.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, email, etc.), change triggers, add integrations, or modify the NanoClaw router; it takes over and asks clarifying questions first.

say_en.text: Help me add a Telegram input channel
say_en.note: It first asks which agent group to wire it to

say_en.text: Change Slack triggers to wake my support agent group
say_en.note: It updates that wiring's trigger rules

say_en.text: Add a Gmail tool to this agent group
say_en.note: It runs /add-gmail-tool to wire the MCP
